verdict.rationale: Apify's client offers mechanisms that let a developer influence latency/completeness trade-offs — e.g. synchronous 'call' that waits for actor completion (apify-docs-23), asynchronous run + webhook notification patterns (apify-docs-14, apify-docs-29), and result-limiting via the `limit`/`maxCrawlPages` parameters (apify-docs-28, apify-docs-15) — but there is no explicit documentation of a dedicated 'return immediately vs wait for full completeness' control (e.g. a documented timeout/waitForFinish knob for partial results) or first-party framing of this exact latency/completeness trade-off. missing for 10: explicit run-timeout/waitForFinish API docs, guidance on streaming partial dataset results while a run is still in progress, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this trade-off pattern.
